authenticity_review: The image exhibits severe structural artifacts that fundamentally undermine authenticity. In the bottom-right car, a bear's head and torso emerge directly through the solid metal roof without any opening, sunroof mechanism, or deformation of the material; this is a physical impossibility and a clear generation error (structural collapse). Additionally, the bears on the top-left car show fusion artifacts where their lower bodies blend indistinctly into the car's trunk/roof line without proper occlusion or contact shadows. While the rendering style is clean and colorful, these logical and physical inconsistencies prevent a high authenticity score. The fine-grained classifier correctly identifying 'teddy bear' rather than 'brown bear' further indicates the model generated stylized toys rather than the biologically specified animal, though this is more an alignment issue than an artifact per se.
key_defects: Counting error: Only 4 bears visible instead of requested 7.
Spatial relationship failure: Bears are on/in cars rather than cars being to the right of bears.
Structural collapse: Bear merging through solid car roof in bottom-right vehicle.
Fusion artifact: Bears on top-left car blend into car body without clear boundaries.
Taxonomy mismatch: Bears are stylized teddy bears, not biological brown bears (missing shoulder hump, dished face, coarse fur).
